hero.description: Each piece is a unique work of art, handmade with passion and refinement. Discover our exclusive collection of collectible dolls, personalized at the highest level of artistic craft.

services.label: Premium Services
services.subtitle: Every order is treated as a unique artistic project. We work closely with our clients to create pieces that reflect their vision with artisanal precision.
services.faceDescription: Hand-sculpted facial features, realistic brush-applied makeup, individual lashes and custom eye colors.
services.bodyDescription: Precise anatomical proportions, functional joints and high-quality finishes made from durable premium materials.
services.coutureDescription: Hand-sewn outfits from luxury fabrics - silk, lace, velvet - with artisan miniature accessories.
services.accessoriesDescription: Miniature jewelry, natural-hair wigs, themed props and personalized collectible presentation boxes.

gallery.label: Art Gallery
gallery.title: Our Collection
gallery.subtitle: Explore the active collections from the catalog - each one reflects hours of dedicated work and refined art.
gallery.emptyDescription: Add active collections from the admin panel to show them on the homepage.

cta.label: Create Something Unique
cta.description: Every collector deserves a piece that represents their vision. Contact us today and let us turn your idea into a work of art made to last a lifetime.

datePicker.hintChooseStart: Choose the start date, then the end date.

details.descriptionParagraph2: It can be chosen for photo sessions, themed decor, private collections or custom orders, depending on availability and the selected mode.
